page_title: Stargazer Bar — GitHub Stars in Your Menu Bar

summary.name: Stargazer Bar
summary.one_liner: A native macOS menu bar app that tracks stars, release downloads, trends, and maintainer activity for multiple public GitHub repos.
use_cases: Watching star counts of several open-source repos at a glance
Tracking release download totals after a launch
Sharing a star or download milestone on social media
Monitoring CI status and new issues for your own projects
Avoiding keeping GitHub tabs open to check repo activity
summary.what_it_does: Stargazer Bar sits in the macOS menu bar and lets you add multiple public GitHub repositories. A compact dropdown shows release download totals from GitHub's latest releases API. Hovering over a repo opens a submenu with stars and forks over all time, one year, or the last month. The same submenu shows CI status, recent commits, new PRs and issues, and unanswered issues. You can copy milestone text or a square image when a repo crosses a rounded star or download mark.
notable: Native Swift app built for Apple silicon, signed and notarized
No backend and no telemetry; settings stored in UserDefaults and optional OAuth tokens in Keychain
Sparkle auto-updates enabled by default with EdDSA signing
caveats: Optional OAuth tokens are available for extra access; no account is needed to start
